fusions.name: Raw Motes
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow cone of raw arcana ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Arcane Relay
fusions.desc: Fires a stinger of arcana that deals 32 damage and ignores resistances. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Dowsing Draught
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds. Motes of arcana fight beside you for 14 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Past Wards
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% arcane resistance.
